Melee Attack Skills are one of the Skill Types. All Melee skills take time to attack which is influenced by Melee Attack Speed and the skills base attack time.

## Contents

- 1 Known Modifiers

- 1.1 Character Stats

- 1.2 Affixes

- 1.3 Equipment Implicits

- 2 List of Melee Attack Skills

- 2.1 NPC

## Known Modifiers[]

### Character Stats[]

- Increased Melee Damage

- Increased Melee Attack Speed

- Strength

### Affixes[]

- Added Melee Cold Damage

- Added Melee Critical Chance

- Added Melee Fire Damage

- Added Melee Necrotic Damage

- Added Melee Lightning Damage

- Added Melee Physical Damage

- Increased Melee Damage

### Equipment Implicits[]

- Most Weapons have added melee damage and/or melee damage types

- Some of the One Handed Blunt Weapons and Two Handed Blunt Weapons have increased melee physical damage

- Stone Hammer and its variants and Nodachi have Increased Melee Damage
